description: The Band Atlas IoT connectivity readiness index (beta, 0-100) for the given countries, or the top 20 when none are given: coverage (share of networks with a sub-1 GHz 4G band, 30%), LTE-M and NB-IoT confirmed on at least one network (30%), 5G and RedCap (20%), device fit (20%), with rank and data confidence. Only confirmed data counts; "not listed" is never taken as "not available", so thinly documented countries may be under-scored.

countries.description: ISO codes or country names; at most 20; leave out for the top 20
